rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone’s kind intentions or disposition to help.

example.english: Your benevolence really shows in the way you helped me move house.
example.traditional: 你咁好心幫我搬屋，真係多謝你。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 hou2 sam1 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1 zan1 hai6 do1 ze6 nei5

rows.note: Use this for a more explicit or enduring charitable disposition, especially when describing someone’s moral character.

example.english: They have shown benevolence all their life and often donate money to charities.
example.traditional: 佢一世人都有善心，成日捐錢畀慈善機構。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 sai3 jan4 dou1 jau5 sin6 sam1 seng4 jat6 gyun1 cin2 bei2 ci4 sin6 gei1 kau3
